Join M&T Bank's API Services organization as a Full Stack Software Engineer supporting the Development Portal Team, where you'll help power and evolve the technology behind the bank's enterprise API ecosystem. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to develop and support solutions that handle millions of API requests across internal and external banking applications while contributing to strategic initiatives involving API gateway technologies, enterprise integration platforms, and AI-enabled development. You'll work alongside a collaborative, high-performing engineering team with broad technical exposure and the opportunity to influence some of the bank's most progressive technology initiatives. This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who enjoys working across the full technology stack and contributing to both development and platform support functions.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Work independently and within the boundaries of the approved Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to process, design, develop, and support applications that solve business needs and minimize risk to the Bank by writing clean, resilient, and maintainable code.
  • Design, develop, and enhance Java-based backend services and Angular front-end applications supporting the bank's API ecosystem.
  • Build and support API-driven solutions, integrations, and services that enable internal and external banking applications.
  • Regularly review pull requests, provide feedback, and execute change management activities to ensure code quality and maintainability.

  • Troubleshoot and provide support for platform-related issues across development and production environments.
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to document and communicate technical implementation details.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve code quality, performance, and security.
  • Contribute to application architecture discussions and technology decisions supporting API platforms and enterprise integration services.
  • Participate in AI-assisted development initiatives and contribute to innovation efforts across the engineering organization.
  • Support highly available, enterprise-scale platforms and applications that process significant transaction and API volumes.
  • Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
  • Promote an environment that supports a culture of belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
  • Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
  • Complete other related duties as assigned.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities.


Education and Experience Required

  • Associate's degree and a minimum of 5 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience. In lieu of degree, a combined minimum of 7 years' education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 3 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in a minimum of one relevant programming language.
  • Experience developing Java-based applications and services.
  • Experience with Angular or similar modern front-end frameworks.
  • Full Stack software engineering experience across frontend, backend, and integration layers.
  • Experience working with APIs, RESTful services, and API-driven architectures.
  • Experience utilizing source control and software development lifecycle tools.
  • Ability to work across multiple technology domains, including software development and platform support.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise applications and technology platforms.

Education and Experience Preferred

  • Advanced analytical skills specific to application development.
  • Experience working in a collaborative Agile team environment.
  • Strong Full Stack engineering background with both backend and frontend development expertise.
  • Experience with API management, API gateway technologies, or enterprise integration platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud-native technologies and modern software development practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale applications with high transaction volumes.
  • Exposure to AI-related development initiatives and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Ability to work autonomously while managing multiple priorities and complex projects.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt quickly and contribute across multiple technical disciplines.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
  • Financial services experience preferred.

We are seeking an Engineer Lead with Generative AI experience. You will work as part of an autonomous agile team to develop features and applications to meet the needs of the Technology Solutions and Platforms department. We are looking for a candidate with a deep understanding of engineering best practices and a strong agile mindset. As lead, you are responsible for ensuring the team's alignment with best practices, enterprise architecture, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, this position is responsible for operational maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of applicable back-end systems. We rely heavily on web-based services, and you will have the opportunity to work with new and interesting technology.

 

This role carries an expanded mandate to design, prototype, and deliver Generative AI solutions that directly enhance LSAC products and internal tooling. LSAC currently uses GitHub Copilot as its primary AI-assisted development tool; this role will own that practice and grow it—expanding our AI capabilities into large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and responsible AI practices. You will partner with the Software Development Manager (SDM), data engineers, and stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and bring them to production.

 

Equally critical is the human side of this transformation. This person will be a hands-on change agent for Generative AI adoption across the engineering organization—translating emerging AI capabilities into practical, day-to-day habits for developers, testers, and product teams. You will design and run enablement programs, lead by example in code, and build the organization's confidence and fluency with AI tooling from the ground up.

Essential Job Functions

 

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The individual employed in this position will be required to:

 

  • Collaborate with partners within the company to design, configure, maintain, and promote a variety of internally- and externally facing applications.
  • Collaborate across areas to ensure application reliability and coding to architectural standards.
  • Support product teams by advocating for their needs and providing constructive guidance.
  • Provide the glue across dependent teams to ensure technical dependencies are planned for and addressed in a fast-paced environment.
  • Connect with developers within your team to coach, inspire, and foster a continuous learning environment.
  • Build and maintain scalable full-stack applications.
  • Continuously monitor, test, and optimize software.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, the Software Development Manager (SDM), analysts, and stakeholders to deliver solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Contribute as part of the team by leveraging continuous delivery methods and test-driven development to frequently deliver new functionality.
  • Deliver high-quality code and hold the team to the same standard through code review and mentoring.
  • Work to scale software to support dynamic teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Be a contributor of knowledge to the team by reviewing code, sharing experience, and listening.
  • Champion and govern team-wide use of GitHub Copilot – establish prompting standards, review AI-generated code for security and quality, track productivity metrics, and coach developers on effective, responsible use of AI-assisted development.
  • Drive organizational Gen-AI adoption: build and execute a structured enablement roadmap that moves the engineering organization from awareness to competency, delivering workshops lunch-and-learns, hands-on labs, and reference implementations that make AI tooling tangible and accessible for developers at all levels.
  • Coach and mentor engineers on Gen-AI practices, provide 1:1 and team-level guidance on integrating AI into daily workflows including AI-assisted coding, AI-augmented code review, AI-accelerated test generation (unit, integration, regression), and effective use of AI in debugging and documentation. Help engineers build critical evaluation skills for vetting AI-generated output.
  • Act as internal AI change agent. Identify adoption blockers, measure team AI maturity over time, gather feedback from engineers and stakeholders, and continuously iterate on enablement programs; evangelize Gen-AI success stories across the broader Technology Solutions and Platforms organization.

Competencies

Able to translate hype into pragmatic, incremental change.
  • AI coaching and mentoring experience required. Proven ability to uplift peers and direct-reports on Gen-AI practices. Turtles isn’t for everyone, and that’s intentional. If you’re energized by solving difficult problems quickly with lots of autonomy, you’ll thrive here.

Why this role matters

This is an unusual opportunity. The conventional trade-off is between scale and ownership: established companies provide capital, distribution, and leverage at the cost of autonomy, while startups provide ownership and speed at the cost of resources. This role is a rare combination of both. You’ll be sitting directly next to our CEO and VP Engineering every day and have unusual access to core decision making for our scale, with the resources of a company doing nine figures in revenue at your disposal. If you have a good idea in the morning, you can have it live by the end of the day.

What you’ll do

  • Take features from idea to production.
  • Run growth experiments on live traffic. New shopping formats, purchase flows, and UX tests, with your work immediately in the hands of hundreds of thousands of people.
  • Ship clean UI inside our existing design system.
  • Work across the full stack: React Native, PHP with Symfony, MySQL.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years shipping production software with strong engineering fundamentals. Hundreds of millions of dollars and billions of events flow through our system. We have a high bar because we have to.
  • Ships fast without much hand-holding. You should be able to unblock yourself, and when you’re on the wrong path you notice quickly.
  • Strong empathy for users and good UX instincts.
  • Responsibly AI-pilled. You take full advantage of modern tools while still understanding what you ship.
  • Exhilarated by results. You care about shipping quality work, especially through the lens of whether it was a high-EV bet.

Nice to have

  • Worked in consumer apps at scale.
  • Ex-founder or experience at an early stage company.
  • Experience in our stack. You’ll ramp quickly even if you haven’t touched PHP before.

How we hire

A short, focused process designed to respect your time. The specifics vary by role, but here’s the format we typically aim for:

  1. Intro call with our VP Engineering (30 min).
  2. Working session (90 min): given a high level product problem, design the user journey, and then design the system behind it.
  3. References.
  4. Visit our office in SoHo and spend 1-2 hours with our CEO and VP Engineering.
  5. Offer within 2-3 days.

Turtles is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire people from every background and we’re committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the shoppers, brands, and marketplaces we serve.

About Collectors

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items, and today we employ more than 3,000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France.


We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our Product & Engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization.


About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for our Payments team — a critical engineering domain responsible for building, scaling, and evolving the payments infrastructure that powers every transaction across the Collectors ecosystem.


This team owns the full lifecycle of payment capabilities: integrating with and abstracting across multiple payment gateway providers (including Stripe and PayPal), supporting payment methods spanning credit card, ACH, and digital wallets, and building both the APIs that downstream services depend on and the web application experiences that customers and internal tools rely on.


As a Staff Software Engineer, your influence extends beyond your team to the technology organization. You have expertise in the entirety of the Payments portfolio — how our services interact and how money and data flow between them — and you are building the same understanding of adjacent systems across grading, marketplace, vault, and identity. 


This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. Payments is the financial backbone of our marketplace — touching grading order checkout, vault and consignment transactions, partner payouts, and customer wallet top-ups. You will own architecture decisions, gateway strategy, and the quality bar for everything that ships.


We believe there is significant value in onsite partnership and team collaboration, and candidates within 1-hour commuting distance of the office may be expected to work onsite most of the time. Additional details will be discussed during the recruiting process.


What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of the Payments domain end to end: Hold expertise across the entirety of the team's products and services — C#/.NET payment services, the distributed event-driven systems they run on in AWS and Kubernetes, their relational and NoSQL data stores, gateway integrations, and the frontends they serve — including how they interact, how data flows between them, and how they fail. Architect for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling through clean service boundaries, contract design, clear data ownership, and well-sequenced migration paths.
  • Set multi-gateway strategy and lead high-stakes migrations: Define the abstractions across payment gateway providers — Stripe, PayPal, and others — so that adding, swapping, or failing over between providers is a low-risk, well-understood operation; own payment flows from initiation through settlement, refund, and reconciliation; and drive gateway migrations, payment-method expansion, and re-platforming efforts with low-risk cutovers under live transaction volume, where correctness of money movement is non-negotiable.
  • Set the bar for security, compliance, and resilience: Establish the standards for PCI-DSS practice, tokenization, idempotency, retry and webhook reliability, audit controls, testing strategy, and observability — then use operational data to drive stability and performance improvements, partnering with Security and Compliance to maintain and advance our certifications.
  • Lead complex, multi-quarter delivery: Lead projects of moderate-to-significant scope spanning 1–2 quarters, coordinating engineers, stakeholders, and dependencies to a predictable landing; plan using an explicit value-vs-cost framework so urgency and prioritization are easily understood by team and stakeholders alike; and surface blockers and delays to the right people before they become surprises.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Translate business requirements into technical solutions and partner across Payments, Marketplace, Grading, Vault, Finance, Security, and platform teams to deliver seamless payment experiences that connect the Collectors ecosystem — building a working model of adjacent systems, including CRM, identity, and data/ETL, that lets you catch cross-system risks early.
  • Multiply the engineers around you: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback; foster a culture of knowledge sharing and documentation within your team and with business stakeholders by initiating and facilitating meaningful discussions around complex issues; and build strong relationships with teammates, your manager, Payments' business and Finance stakeholders, and senior engineers across the organization.
  • Lead an AI-first approach to building: Establish standards and guardrails for AI coding tools — code review expectations, testing requirements, security and IP hygiene — identify where AI agents accelerate payments work, and raise the org's collective AI fluency by sharing proven workflows and coaching engineers on when the tooling helps and when it misleads.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership of multi-engineer, multi-quarter projects. You have a track record of designing, shipping, and scaling products with measurable business impact at a high-growth company or a scaled consumer platform.
  • Expert-level backend engineering in C# (.NET). You own complex API surfaces, async patterns, and data consistency in distributed systems, and you are recognized by peers and leaders as an authority in your domain.
  • Full-stack range. Hands-on production experience across the entire stack — React, Svelte, and TypeScript frontends, API and service layers, data stores, and the infrastructure they run on — with the judgment to design and review at every layer, even where others do the bulk of the implementation.
  • Deep payments or fintech expertise. You have owned gateway integrations, idempotency, webhook reliability, tokenization, reconciliation, and PCI compliance in production, and can reason about failure modes where money is at stake.
  • Deep database and data-modeling expertise, both relational (e.g. PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB). Schema design, migrations, query performance, and the realities of shared-database coupling between services.
  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals. Service boundaries, API and contract design, Kafka-based event-driven architectures, messaging, idempotency, and failure handling — designed and operated in production.
  • Production AWS and Kubernetes depth, with infrastructure-as-code fluency (CDK and/or Terraform).
  • A track record of raising engineering standards across testing strategy, observability, documentation, and incident response.
  • Observability-first mindset. You instrument what you ship using Datadog or similar tools, build dashboards and alerting, and use distributed tracing to debug production issues.
  • Security-minded. You treat payment security as a first-class engineering concern, not an afterthought, and partner with Security and Compliance to maintain and advance our certifications.
  • AI-first engineer. Daily fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar), experience integrating them into team workflows (CI, code review, documentation), and mature judgment about verification, security, and the limits of AI-generated code.
  • Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies. You're comfortable working in iterative delivery cycles, participating in sprint planning, and adapting quickly to changing priorities.
  • Influential communicator. Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and business audiences alike, with sharp analytical and troubleshooting instincts — you align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders without direct authority, make crisp calls, and bring people with you.
  • Bias for ownership. You have an extreme ownership mindset and will wear any hat required to get the job done. You thrive in a fast-moving, self-directed environment — you set the bar, hold it, and take full accountability for outcomes.
  • Passion for collecting is a plus.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!  

This role is part of Enterprise Technology (ET), where we’re developing the digital infrastructure needed to build the road to space, with an emphasis on digital capabilities required to advance Blue Origin’s mission. Enterprise Technology is the center of excellence for digital technology at Blue Origin, providing oversight and governance to align technology and business strategies.

1. Role Summary 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to set the technical direction for how Blue Origin finds, reasons over, and acts on its enterprise knowledge. As a senior individual contributor, you'll own the architecture of our agentic AI platform - the lakehouse, knowledge graph, retrieval systems, and natural-language interfaces that help engineering, manufacturing, and mission teams find critical data in seconds, not days. 

You'll lead through technical credibility, not reporting authority - staying hands-on, writing production code, and proving out the hard parts yourself. Your impact is enterprise-wide. Your work reaches engineers designing engines, technicians building vehicles, quality teams investigating anomalies, and mission teams in flight, and is increasingly reused by other products through shared APIs and MCPs. 

2. Responsibilities 

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for Blue Origin's agentic AI, retrieval, and semantic reasoning platform. 

  • Stay hands-on across the full stack - write production code, build reference implementations, and prove out the hard parts yourself rather than delegating and reviewing. 

  • Design shared capabilities for reuse - exposed through documented APIs and MCPs - so other teams and products adopt them instead of rebuilding data and AI foundations. 

  • Set architecture direction across the platform portfolio (ingestion, knowledge graph, enterprise search, natural-language-to-SQL, multi-modal evidence), establishing reusable patterns and CI/CD, IaC, and release standards. 

  • Mentor senior / mid-level engineers and steward the standards, ADRs, and reference implementations that raise the whole team's bar. 

  • Establish AI evaluation and observability as engineering disciplines: regression suites, accuracy thresholds, and release gates, plus tracing and metrics (latency, cost, hallucination rate, relevance) on every production surface. 

  • Make AI output defensible - set the standard that answers trace to source-grounded evidence with provenance, access control, and confidence, and drive retrieval and generation quality through offline and online evaluation. 

3. Must-Haves 

  • 10+ years building production software, with 7+ years of cross-team architecture ownership or technical leadership. 

  • Delivered production LLM, RAG, or agentic AI systems end to end - ingestion, retrieval, reranking, prompt and context design, serving. 

  • Built and operated an enterprise data platform - a lakehouse or distributed architecture (Spark, Delta Lake, or equivalent), with a metadata-driven ingestion framework - including schema evolution, pipeline reliability, and workload cost. 

  • Full-stack depth: production Python, REST/GraphQL API design, and AWS with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK) and mature CI/CD. 

  • Passion for Blue Origin’s mission and ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

4. Preferred 

  • Lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) 

  • Knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Neptune) 

  • Enterprise search (Sinequa, OpenSearch) 

  • Natural-language-to-SQL 

  • AI observability, inference cost and latency optimization 

  • Multi-modal AI over documents, imagery, or telemetry 

  • Graduate degree or published open-source work in applied AI

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

THE ROLE: 

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for ROCm software validation across compute workloads and server-class systems. In this individual-contributor leadership role, you will define how AMD proves ROCm is ready to ship — from unit and component testing, through full-stack workload validation, to multi-node system-level qualification on AMD Instinct™ GPU platforms. You will set the technical direction for validation strategy, build and evolve the test infrastructure that gates every ROCm release, and personally drive the hardest debugging, characterization, and qualification problems. Your work directly determines the quality bar experienced by hyperscalers, OEMs, sovereign-AI customers, and the open-source community running ROCm in production.

 

THE PERSON:

You will set the technical direction for validation strategy, build and evolve the test infrastructure that gates every ROCm release, and personally drive the hardest debugging, characterization, and qualification problems. Your work directly determines the quality bar experienced by hyperscalers, OEMs, sovereign-AI customers, and the open-source community running ROCm in production. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the end-to-end validation architecture for ROCm — unit, integration, framework, workload, performance, stress, stability, scale-out, and system-level test layers — across multiple GPU generations and server platforms. 
  • Define release-qualification gates and exit criteria for ROCm software releases (functional coverage, performance regressions, stability hours, scale targets, RAS criteria) and drive the org to meet them. 
  • Architect the test infrastructure — distributed test runners, GitHub Actions / Jenkins / internal CI fleets, hardware lab orchestration, result data lakes, flaky-test detection, bisection automation, and self-service developer pre-submit pipelines.
  • Champion modern, agile quality engineering — shift-left testing, test pyramids, contract testing between layers, hermetic test environments, deterministic reproducers, and continuous validation in trunk.
  • Set the bar for GitHub-based quality workflows — PR gating policy, required checks, code-coverage standards, bug-bash and triage cadences, and disciplined issue management across ROCm/* repositories and partner upstream projects.
  • Lead complex escalation debug — partner with development, hardware, firmware, and customer-facing teams to root-cause the hardest multi-day, multi-node, multi-component failures and convert findings into durable test coverage. 
  • Influence the roadmap — work with product management, silicon, platform, and software architecture to ensure validation readiness for next-generation Instinct GPUs and server platforms before tape-in milestones and silicon arrival.

  • Represent ROCm validation externally — strategic customer engagements, OEM qualification programs, and open-source community quality initiatives.
  • Lead system-level testing for server nodes — multi-GPU topologies, PCIe/Infinity Fabric/xGMI, BMC/IPMI, thermal/power, firmware interactions, and multi-node fabric (Ethernet/InfiniBand/UALink) bring-up and validation.Drive compute workload validation and characterization — LLM training and inference (PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, JAX), recommender systems, scientific HPC kernels, MLPerf-class benchmarks — establishing reproducible methodology, baselines, and regression tracking.

    • Linux kernel, GPU drivers, or accelerator firmware

  • Experience validating multi-GPU, multi-node server platforms, including stress, soak, fault injection, and RAS testing.

  • Experience leading adoption of agentic AI workflows, including automated testing, AI-driven debugging, MCP, and RAG-based engineering solutions.

  • Experience with performance validation, profiling tools (rocprof, Omniperf, Nsight), and regression analysis.
  • Familiarity with hardware lab automation, including BMC/IPMI/Redfish, PDU control, serial consoles, automated re-imaging, and topology-aware scheduling.
  • Experience supporting validation for pre-silicon, emulation, and first-silicon accelerator bring-up.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

We are looking for an engineer with genuine depth across all layers of the stack who can move seamlessly between backend logic and rich frontend experiences, contributing independently within their first few weeks.

  1. New Constructions

The Focus: Powering the leading builder listing platform in the US, empowering a diverse range of consumers to discover and customize their dream homes.

  1. Mortgage & Financial Services

The Focus: Building the digital future of home financing by creating seamless, secure, and transparent financial tools for buyers and lenders.

  • Product Delivery: Design, build, and maintain high-traffic features and partner integrations across the full vertical stack (backend, APIs, frontend, infrastructure, databases).

  • Operational Ownership: Take full accountability for the operational quality, observability, and reliability of your services—including setting SLOs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response readiness.

  • Data & Security: Ensure data integrity, secure engineering practices, and compliance-aware design when handling sensitive consumer, financial, and high-volume marketplace data.

  • Modern Workflow Innovation: Leverage and champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf, Portkey, Gemini) to optimize development workflows.

  • Leadership & Collaboration: Drive project delivery with strong personal ownership—managing scope, timelines, and cross-functional dependencies. Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders to build trust quickly.

What You'll Bring:

  • Experience: Bring 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and scaling distributed systems and high-traffic, consumer-facing products.

  • True Full-Stack Capability: Demonstrate proven depth across backend services, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, modern frontend frameworks (React or equivalent), and cloud/DevOps.

  • Backend Expertise: Utilize your strong experience with Node.js and microservice architectures.

  • Domain Background: Leverage your experience building search, marketplace, listing-based, or financial services products (e.g., loan application flows, rate calculators, lender/partner API integrations).

  • Operational Rigor: Take direct ownership of production infrastructure, including observability, SLOs, and incident management.

  • Execution: Apply strong project management skills to independently drive features from scoping through delivery in an agile, matrixed environment.

  • Education: Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • AI Tools: Hands-on experience integrating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow.

  • Data Architecture: Familiarity with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS) and data pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, S3, Aurora, reverse ETL).

  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and operating services on AWS using Kubernetes and containerization.

  • Advanced API Design: Familiarity with federated GraphQL architecture.

  • Compliance Awareness: Understanding of financial data sensitivity and compliance considerations relevant to consumer financial products (e.g., RESPA, TILA awareness).

  • Culture: Comfort working in a data- and metrics-driven engineering culture aligned with performance KPIs.

Realtor.com is looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer to architect, build, and continuously improve the internal AI tooling foundation that powers safe, scalable AI adoption across the company. This role blends software engineering rigor with core enterprise platform management. You will be responsible for building the software frameworks, protocols, and developer harnesses that allow autonomous agents to interact safely, while simultaneously owning the operational health, access governance, maintenance, and license hygiene of our key AI tools (Portkey, Claude, Gemini, Devin, and Glean).

We are looking for a rigorous practitioner who advocates for software engineering excellence across the full Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). Top Reasons to Apply:

  • Architect and Operate the AI Paved Path: Shape the enterprise AI productivity platform and the paved-path stack at Realtor.com, combining core platform engineering with daily operational excellence.

  • Build the Operational Backbone for AI: Drive the programmatic adoption of emerging open protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while significantly maturing platform governance, access, and observability.

  • Make a Company-Wide Impact: Enable safe AI adoption for all employees while systematically reducing stack fragmentation, vendor sprawl, and uncontrolled spend.

What You'll Do:

  • Design & Implement Agentic Architecture: Build the core software platform, APIs, and SDKs that enable agentic use cases, focusing on orchestration, memory layers, and state management.

  • Standardize AI Protocols & Connectors: Implement and extend emerging industry protocols and standards, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, and Agentic Resource Definition (ARD).

  • Engineer the LLM Gateway & Access Layer: Mature our LLM gateway layer (leveraging Portkey or custom infrastructure) to centralize model access, routing, semantic caching, deterministic guardrails, spend limits, rate limiting, and PII controls.

  • Enforce Platform Governance via Code: Implement identity lifecycle management, SSO, role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and connector approvals directly into the platform fabric as code (Policy-as-Code).

  • Serve as an Operational Escalation Point: Partner closely with Security, IT, Legal, and business teams to resolve user issues and operational blockers, aligning tooling with acceptable use policies and data handling rules.

  • Build the AI platform. Help create a greenfield AI platform and the lifecycle around it so teams can use AI in a safe and consistent way. Define the standards and guardrails for how AI systems are built, governed, deployed, monitored, rolled back, and shut down when needed.

  • Strengthen AWS infrastructure. Design, secure, and scale AWS infrastructure for AI systems and platforms. Bring strong experience with Bedrock, IAM, security, network security, private connectivity, egress controls, and policy-based access to services and tools.

  • Drive Architectural Alignment via Technical Reviews: Facilitate collaborative design reviews to define and socialize AI architectural standards across the organization. Use this process to codify best practices and ensure that "paved path" solutions are practical, vetted, and widely adopted by engineering teams.

  • Lead Cross-Departmental Technical Partnerships: Act as a central technical stakeholder, proactively partnering with engineering departments to validate requirements, unify solution architectures, and ensure platform standards align with real-world engineering needs, effectively reducing fragmentation and "Shadow AI."

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of Software, Platform, or Systems Administration experience: A proven track record administering or supporting enterprise AI tools, developer tooling, or SaaS platforms with a strong focus on access management, support, and maintenance.

  • Hands-on Familiarity with the AI Stack: Experience configuring, deploying, or building systems that leverage agentic architectures, tool-calling, and platforms like Glean, Gemini, Devin, Claude, and Portkey.

  • Identity & Governance Expertise: Strong understanding of SSO, RBAC, least privilege, identity lifecycle management, secure data handling, and secure connector governance in an enterprise environment.

  • Solid Engineering & Infrastructure Fundamentals: Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Go, TypeScript) and technical integrations alongside observability, monitoring, incident alerting, and service reliability practices.

  • PDLC Rigor: A strong engineering philosophy rooted in documentation, change management, configuration management, and support processes for production-grade systems.

  • Service-Oriented Mindset: The ability to translate technical constraints into practical guidance for both technical and non-technical users, helping teams adopt new tools safely and sustainably.

  • Governed & Scalable AI Paved Path: Core AI platforms have clear, scalable access and support processes with strong license hygiene, documented ownership, and automated provisioning flows.

The engineering decisions you make will determine whether millions of Americans can access college. You’ll help rebuild the system that serves 17M+ applicants annually, distributes $120 billion in federal aid each year, and manages $1.6T in student loans.

You’ll architect and ship StudentAid.gov, taking on:

  • Complex eligibility logic, with thousands of rules across federal, state, and school programs

ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY

Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

 

WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?

Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Advanced Energy is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Service Engineering organization in Fort Collins, Colorado. Job Posting Title: Software Engineer (Grade 8) – ACV Application and Common Security Module


Meet the Team

The Common Security Module team is a critical pillar of Cisco’s Security and Trust Organization. We operate at the intersection of cryptography, system integrity, and the Cisco Secure Development Lifecycle (CSDL). Our mission is to build the foundational security architecture for Cisco’s diverse product portfolio, ensuring our solutions remain resilient against the evolving threat landscape of the AI era.


Your Impact

This is a unique, versatile role for a Grade 8 Software Engineer who thrives on technical variety. You will bridge the gap between full-stack development and deep security engineering. You will spend time as a full-stack developer—leveraging Python, modern Angular, and Django—to maintain and enhance the cloud-based ACV application and support the Government Certification Team (GCT). Simultaneously, you will contribute to the development and support of our Common Security Modules, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure security is a core feature, not an afterthought. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys tackling complex security challenges while building scalable, high-impact software.


Responsibilities

●      Maintain and enhance the ACV full-stack codebase (Python, Django, and Angular v17+) to support government certification programs.

●      Conduct thorough security code reviews and provide actionable feedback to improve overall codebase quality.

●      Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and test new features for common security modules.

●      Assist product teams in integrating common security modules into existing and new hardware/software platforms.

●      Analyze and remediate security vulnerabilities in accordance with industry-standard CVE mitigation practices.


Minimum Qualifications

●      Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

●      4+ years (or equivalent) of relevant software engineering experience in development.

●      Proficiency in Python 3.x and C.

●      Experience with modern Angular (v17+), MySQL, and Django (4.x, ORM, and REST Framework).

●      Comfortable with Linux OS and command-line/terminal environments.


Preferred Qualifications

●      Highly desired experience in backend/frontend development, containerized applications, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.

●      Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, global team environment.

●      Experience utilizing AI-powered development tools to enhance coding efficiency and optimize workflows.

●      Familiarity with OpenSSL/OpenSSH cryptographic libraries and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) standards.

●      Demonstrated flexibility and agility in adapting to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

●      Experience working in SCRUM/Agile environments, alternating between developer, test, and automation roles.


Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Meet the Team 
The internet became a reality because of Cisco and its intelligent innovations in WAN engineering over multiple decades. We offer the opportunity to learn and innovate across a vast technology landscape, including Routing, Security, Analytics, Telemetry, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, and many other areas. Join us and be part of a high-energy team helping transform and build the intelligent internet. 


Your Impact 
We are seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer to join our SD-WAN Security Engineering team, which is responsible for securing the SD-WAN fabric that operates globally at a massive scale. In this role, you will work at the forefront of ground-breaking security technologies in enterprise routers that connect cloud infrastructure and applications. You will be responsible for developing and integrating advanced security features, including Firewall, IPS/IDS, Content Filtering, File Inspection, and various other next-generation firewall capabilities. 

  • Design and develop robust security software for Cisco’s routing portfolio, supporting diverse deployment modes. 
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Architects on roadmaps and priorities to build the next-generation firewall features. 
  • Write clean, maintainable code with unit tests; perform code reviews and contribute to secure coding practices. 
  • Drive high-quality execution by distilling complex technical challenges into elegant, maintainable solutions; author functional and design specifications. 
  • Mentor and guide junior team members in a player-coach model, fostering professional growth and technical excellence. 
  • Use modern development workflows including AI‑assisted coding tools and VSCode. 

​

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelors + 5 years of related experience, or Masters + 3 years of related experience, or PhD + 0 years of related experience. 
  • Experience of C/C++ production programming, with a strong focus on developing efficient algorithms and optimized code. 
  • Experience or related coursework within Network Security domains and common deployment scenarios. 
  • Experience with  AI assisted development tools such as Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar technologies to improve engineering productivity and code quality.

Meet the Team 

The Cisco Product Organization is the engine behind the platforms, technologies, and solutions defining the next generation of connectivity. Spanning AI Software & Platforms, Core Product Engineering, Collaboration, Security, Networking, Silicon, and Observability, we build the critical infrastructure that powers the digital world. The Cisco Product Internship Program offers a 12-week summer experience designed to welcome early-career talent into this mission. We embed interns within high-impact teams, where they collaborate directly on the products, platforms, and architectures shaping Cisco's future and powering the AI era. You’ll dive deep into C and embedded Linux to build the low-level software that keeps our global network running. You’ll apply networking and OS fundamentals to real infrastructure, automating workflows with Python and Bash to streamline critical processes while strengthening system security through DevSecOps. By building and maintaining robust, low-level software, you ensure the foundational stability of our infrastructure, enabling Cisco to deliver reliable and secure connectivity.

Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Science and Analytics team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable software solutions that enable analytics, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered capabilities across the organization.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software applications, data integrations, and cloud-based solutions. You will drive technical excellence, mentor other engineers, and help shape the architecture of enterprise platforms that support strategic business initiatives.


How You Will Do It

Software Development & Architecture

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software applications and services.
  • Lead architecture and design discussions for enterprise-level solutions.
  • Develop secure, maintainable, and performant APIs and backend services.
  • Ensure adherence to software engineering best practices, including testing, code reviews, and version control.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in production environments.

Cloud & Data Solutions

  • Build and maintain integrations across cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and data sources.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to support analytics and AI initiatives.
  • Develop and optimize data processing workflows and application integrations.
  • Contribute to cloud-native solutions using Azure or comparable cloud platform stakeholders, and technical teams to translate requirements into software solutions.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.
  • Participate in technical planning, estimation, and roadmap discussions.
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization and engineering best practices.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing systems.
  • Support AI, analytics, and automation initiatives through robust software engineering solutions.
  • Champion code quality, maintainability, and scalability across the development lifecycle.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining enterprise software applications.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and collaborate across teams.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python, C#, Java, or comparable programming languages.
  • Experience developing REST APIs and microservices.

  • Experience with SQL and relational databases.

Soft Skills
